protocol: UMD 3.28.2 continued frozen gold-blind retrieval exam

text_segmentation.memoryarena_unit: one completed prior subtask and successful observation
text_segmentation.longmemeval_v2_unit: one full multimodal trajectory serialized without screenshots

capacity_tiers.MemoryAgentBench: contexts with at most 600 fixed chunks
capacity_tiers.EverMemBench: 50 questions sampled at uniform positions from each of five datasets
capacity_tiers.LongMemEval-V2: 50 questions sampled at uniform positions from each of two small-tier haystacks; goal/action/thought notes are indexed

benchmarks.MemoryAgentBench: answer-bearing passage retrieval for Accurate Retrieval and Conflict Resolution only
benchmarks.EverMemBench: answer-bearing date-by-group retrieval on five English dynamic group-chat datasets
benchmarks.MemoryBench: answer-bearing session retrieval on the three DialSim datasets
benchmarks.MemoryArena: prior-subtask answer-component reuse retrieval; not environment success
benchmarks.LongMemEval-V2: small-tier answer-bearing trajectory retrieval; not reader accuracy or LAFS
benchmarks.MemoryBench-temporal: retrieve the historical session date explicitly stated in each DialSim question; no hidden answer label
